evals.prompt: Review src/payments/ for refactoring. The tests are in tests/payments/ and run with npm test.
evals.expected_output: Sets the refactor scope to every file under src/payments/, leaves test files out, and lists the contract: every symbol imported from outside the scope, endpoints, flags, and config keys. Records a baseline in the scratch directory, including the code-measure summary run from the project root with --test-report and --coverage-report, and never writes a report into the repository. Reads every file in scope against references/smell-catalog.md; a number alone is never a finding. Writes one task with one subtask per refactoring, ordered Remove Dead Code, Rename, in-function, then cross-module, each subtask with one verification command that fails on the current code. Changes no project code and asks no question. Saves <tasks-dir>/###-refactor-<slug>/task.md and ###-<subtask-slug>.md files. The last message is one line: the task file path.

evals.prompt: Refactor scope: lib/legacy/parser.js. This repo has no test command and no test files at all.
evals.expected_output: Records that there is no test setup. Keeps only entries from the safe set: Rename, Extract Variable, Inline Variable, Extract Function, Move Function, Remove Dead Code, each marked 'tests: none: safe set' with a structural check as its sole verification command. Every other finding goes under the task's Out of scope with the reason 'no test setup'. No subtask names a test or a test framework.

evals.prompt: Refactor main..HEAD. The branch only touched README.md and a lockfile.
evals.expected_output: The refactor scope is empty after removing lockfiles and non-code files, so no task is written and no folder is created. The skill states the refactor scope and the baseline measurements in chat, then finishes with one line: `No refactor task: no finding met the rules of Step 5.` It asks nothing else.
